note: NEW FAMILY (v0.6.0, hand-authored spec fixture — the i18n routes never existed in Flask; there is no recording, this fixture IS the contract, DECISIONS.md 2026-08-22). Unauthenticated — no Authorization header, no cookie, no 401 path exists on this family. Empty list whenever the server has no packs cached (fresh instance, I18N_OFFLINE=1, or GitHub unreachable with a cold cache): the object envelope with an empty array, never a bare array and never an error. English is NEVER listed by the server even when an en pack is cached — the frontend unions bundled English into the picker itself. Cache-Control only on this endpoint; the languages list carries no ETag (owner decision — the list has no single stable version identity; see DECISIONS.md 2026-08-22).
